title: Dynamic Hyperparameter Importance for Efficient Multi-Objective Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2601.03166v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Choosing a suitable ML model is a complex task that can depend on several objectives, e.g., accuracy, fairness, or energy consumption. In practice, this requires trading off multiple, often competing, objectives through multi-objective optimization (MOO). However, existing MOO methods typically treat all hyperparameters as equally important, disregarding that hyperparameter importance (HPI) can vary significantly across objectives. We propose a novel dynamic optimization approach that prioritizes the most influential hyperparameters based on varying objective trade-offs during the search, thereby accelerating empirical convergence. We advance prior work on HPI for MOO from post-analysis to direct, dynamic integration within the optimization, using HyperSHAP, a recent HPI method that attributes performance gains to hyperparameters via Shapley values. For this, we leverage the objective weightings naturally produced by the MOO algorith

translated_title: 面向高效多目标优化的动态超参数重要性
translated_abstract: 选择合适的机器学习模型是一项复杂的任务，可能取决于多个目标，例如准确率、公平性或能耗。在实践中，这需要通过多目标优化（MOO）来权衡多个通常相互竞争的目标。然而，现有的MOO方法通常将所有超参数视为同等重要，忽略了超参数重要性（HPI）在不同目标之间可能存在显著差异这一事实。我们提出了一种新颖的动态优化方法，该方法在搜索过程中根据不断变化的目标权衡来优先考虑最具影响力的超参数，从而加速经验收敛。我们将先前关于MOO中超参数重要性的研究从后验分析推进到优化过程中的直接动态集成，所使用的HyperSHAP是一种最新的超参数重要性方法，它通过Shapley值将性能提升归因于各个超参数。为此，我们利用了MOO算法自然产生的目标权重……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种动态优化方法，将基于Shapley值的超参数重要性分析从后验分析转变为在多目标优化过程中直接动态集成，根据目标权衡的变化优先处理最具影响力的超参数，从而加速优化收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dynamic optimization approach that moves hyperparameter importance analysis from post-analysis to direct, dynamic integration within multi-objective optimization, using Shapley values to prioritize the most influential hyperparameters based on evolving objective trade-offs and thereby accelerate empirical convergence.
